knx-systemintegrator.intro: Modern properties deserve intelligent technology. With KNX, you rely on a proven, future-proof system for fully integrated control of your building functions – individually planned, professionally implemented.

sections.title: Comfort, efficiency and safety
sections.html:
Whether it's an exclusive villa in Mallorca or a commercial property in Cologne, KNX technology combines sophisticated architecture with precise technology. Lighting, heating, blinds, ventilation, and security systems can be centrally controlled, automated, and adapted to your lifestyle or work habits—even on the go via smartphone or tablet.

Our team plans, installs, and supports your KNX solution holistically – from the initial design through system integration to long-term maintenance. We rely exclusively on high-quality components from leading manufacturers and combine technology with design excellence.

sections.title: Our services in the field of KNX
sections.html:
• Individual consulting & system planning
    Based on your property and your needs, we develop a holistic concept – functional, expandable, and future-proof.

  • Installation & commissioning
    Whether it's a new build or a retrofit, we ensure professional implementation with an eye for detail. KNX can also be easily integrated into existing systems.

  • Maintenance & Expansion
    Your technology remains reliable over the long term – through regular updates, maintenance, and customized expansion options.

sections.title: Certified KNX partner
sections.html:
As a certified KNX partner, we offer solutions for:

  • Exclusive residential properties
    e.g., intelligent lighting control, smart air conditioning, and elegant switch designs

  • Commercial and industrial buildings
    e.g., efficient energy use, automatic shading, and needs-based security technology

faq.a: KNX is the globally recognized standard (EN 50090 / ISO/IEC 14543) for the intelligent networking of home and building technology. It enables centralized, cross-manufacturer control of lighting, shading, heating, security, and more – efficiently, securely, and scalably.

faq.q: Can KNX be retrofitted in existing buildings?
faq.a: Yes. In addition to the traditional bus (TP), there are wireless and IP options. We will review the existing infrastructure and plan a suitable integration.

faq.q: Do you handle maintenance and extensions?
faq.a: Yes. We handle updates, error analysis, enhancements, and reprogramming – across all manufacturers and with long-term service in Cologne and the surrounding area.

faq.q: How much does a KNX installation cost?
faq.a: This depends on the scope (trades, sensors/actuators, visualization). After an on-site appointment, you will receive a binding quote with a detailed description of the work.

faq.q: Why is it difficult to find good KNX electricians?
faq.a: KNX requires certification (KNX partner), in-depth ETS knowledge, and interdisciplinary experience across multiple disciplines. Qualified integrators are specialized and therefore rare – we ensure this through certified expertise and numerous completed projects.

sections.html:

According to YouTube, in "enhanced privacy mode," only data is transmitted to the YouTube server, specifically which of our websites you visited when watching the video.
